entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I assist you today?
Hi Isaac. I'm calling because I'd like to return a pair of cycling shoes I bought a couple of months ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the cycling shoes were delivered about 78 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's a fit issue. I've given them a fair try, even adjusted the cleats multiple times, but I keep getting painful blisters after any ride longer than an hour. They just don't seem to work for my feet.

I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is the last thing you want when you're out on a ride. Comfort is key with cycling shoes. Since the purchase is within our 90-day policy, I can definitely process a full refund for you. I'm sending a prepaid return label to your email on file right now.

That's good to hear, thank you for making that straightforward. I am planning to buy a different model from your website, but this experience has made me a little cautious. Given the inconvenience, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase?

That's a fair question. Let me see... I can see here that you're a VIP member with us, and we definitely want to help you find a pair of shoes you love. I can absolutely add a 15% discount code to the email I'm sending with your return label. You can apply that to your next order with us.
A 15% discount code would be perfect. Thank you, Isaac, I really appreciate you doing that.
Of course. We want to make sure you're taken care of. The email with the label and the code has been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help.
You're very welcome. Have a great rest of your day.
